snippet.title: Season 01 Launch Trailer | Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
snippet.description:
The biggest Black Ops season ever drops on December 4. Are you ready? 😱

Gear up for 6 more Multiplayer maps, an out-of-this-world Round-Based Zombies map & two Survival experiences, Endgame World Events, plus a stacked arsenal of 7 weapons, Weekly Challenges, and more 💥
